# E3 Phase 1 — Variability screen of the 99-object ZTF cadence sample

*(memo section; generated by `e3_screen.py`, results in `screen_table.json`, 2026-07-10)*

The 99 cached objects are magnitude-selected (14–18.5) field stars, not
confirmed variables. Before treating them as a near-null real sample we
screened every underlying ZTF star:

**Method.** (1) Each of the 155 per-band oids was resolved to its own IRSA
`ztf_objects_dr23` position — necessary because `same_field_cadence` pair
members are *different stars*, up to ~0.7 deg apart, so the single metadata
ra/dec covers only one member. The 155 oids dedupe to 147 unique stars
(1″ tolerance: 8 same_star + 2×48 pairs + 43 single-band). (2) Every star
was crossmatched at ≤2″ against Chen+2020 (VizieR `J/ApJS/249/18/table2`)
and Gaia DR3 variables (`gaiadr3.vari_summary` ⋈ `gaia_source` ⋈
`vari_classifier_result`, ESA TAP), via batched OR-CONTAINS cone queries
(≤10 circles/query, ≤1 req/s, per-batch cache). A known Chen+2020 RRc was
run as a positive control and recovered in both catalogs at <0.1″.
(3) Per band (catflags==0, all 155 band-LCs have ≥221 epochs) we computed
`ratio = 1.4826·MAD(mag) / median(magerr)`; sample-relative outlier flags:
**flag** at ratio ≥ median+5σ_MAD = 2.19, **marginal** at ≥ median+3σ_MAD
= 1.74 (sample median 1.08, σ_MAD 0.22 — ZTF magerr is well calibrated
for this sample).

**Results (n = 99 objects):**

| category | n | objects |
|---|---|---|
| catalog-matched variable | 7 | g00015 (Chen EW P=1.207 d + Gaia ECL), g00017 (Chen EW P=0.464 d), g00034 (Gaia YSO 0.92), g00046 (Gaia RS 0.28), g00052 (Gaia **AGN** 0.92), g00070 (Gaia SOLAR_LIKE 0.33), g00080 (Gaia S 0.06) |
| amplitude-flagged (≥5σ_MAD) | 8 | g00011, g00015, g00016, g00017, g00018 (r ratio 13.8), g00056, g00065, g00079 |
| amplitude marginal only (3–5σ_MAD) | 7 | g00020, g00021, g00038, g00046, g00052, g00058, g00064 |
| **clean (none of the above)** | **81** | 8/8 same_star, 37/48 same_field_cadence, 36/43 single_band |

All 7 catalog matches have separations ≤0.25″. Both Chen EWs are also
≥5σ amplitude-flagged (screen self-consistency). Six amplitude-flagged
objects have no catalog counterpart (g00011, g00016, g00018,
g00056, g00065, g00079) — candidate uncataloged variables or photometric
artifacts; either way they are excluded from the clean set. Gaia "matched"
means membership in `vari_summary` (Gaia flagged the source variable);
class names with low `best_class_score` (g00080 S=0.06, g00046 RS=0.28,
g00070 SOLAR_LIKE=0.33) are weak labels but the variability flag stands.
g00052 is classified AGN (score 0.92), i.e. not a star at all.

**Implication for the false-alarm comparison (Phase 2).** The sample is
confirmed near-null: only 2/99 are confirmed periodic variables in the
search band's reach (both EW eclipsers), and 81/99 pass all screens.
Downstream max-power comparisons to the D1 / matched nulls should be run
on all 99 with the 18 screened objects marked, and the null-consistency
statement made on the 81-object clean subset (which retains all 8
physical two-band same_star objects). Caveats: n=99 ⇒ FAP floor ~1%;
Gaia DR3 positions are epoch 2016.0, so a ≫100 mas/yr proper-motion star
could evade the 2″ match (none expected at these magnitudes).
